svg.title: F-08: Annual Grazing Calendar — Paddock Rotation Sequence and Rest Periods by Month
svg.desc: Annual grazing calendar showing 8-paddock rotation schedule across 12 months. Rows represent paddocks P1–P8 plus a sacrifice paddock. Columns represent months Jan–Dec. Cells are colored by status: actively grazing (dark green), resting/recovering (light green), or sacrifice/dry-season reserve (amber). Seasonal bands show wet, transition, and dry seasons.
svg.text: F-08 — Annual grazing calendar · 8-paddock rotation · tropical lowland system
Illustrative rotation sequence · adjust entry/exit dates by forage height, not calendar · Sonora: shift wet season to Jul–Sep
Figure F-08 · Calendar shows one representative annual cycle · trigger for moving cattle is always forage height (25–35 cm entry, ~15 cm exit), not calendar date
Sonora adaptation: wet season Jul–Sep only (3 months) · dry season Oct–Jun · minimum 10 paddocks recommended for semi-arid rangeland
